source.title: New open problems and conjectures in the new mathematical coloring book

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/8009519 for document identifier 8009519.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/8009519 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH API resolved the exact record as Alexander Soifer's 2024 journal article 'New open problems and conjectures in the new mathematical coloring book', Zbl identifier 1559.05062, published in Geombinatorics 34, No. 1, pages 30-36. The API record contained bibliographic metadata but no full-text links.

Identifier-specific recovery found no DOI, arXiv identifier, publisher PDF, EuDML link, Geodesic link, or repository link for the same exact article in the zbMATH API record. The Geombinatorics Volume XXXIV page confirmed the article's issue placement and page start but exposed only the table of contents, not the article body or a downloadable full-text artifact.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-title, exact-title plus PDF, exact-title plus Geombinatorics, Crossref title search, and OpenAlex title search. Rejected candidates included Springer, ResearchGate, Google Books, bookseller, and OpenAlex/Crossref records for the book 'The New Mathematical Coloring Book' because they are a different work rather than the Geombinatorics article; other search results were citation-only pages, snippets, or the Geombinatorics table of contents without problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, resolver records, abstracts, search snippets, citation-only pages, table-of-contents entries, or a different book record. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-8009519.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
